title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Course Registration
All
students
may register in courses and drop courses using LORIS. Details regarding registration procedures, including exact dates, are available online.
Fall and Winter Registration Dates:
Returning Students: Returning students will normally register according to a schedule of dates determined by the total credits earned and in progress.
New Year One Students: New Year 1 students will normally register after having received and confirmed the Offer of Admission.
Spring, Intersession, and Summer Registration Dates:
All Students: General registration begins in February
